added_failure_basis: The reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite and after_suite keys because no test file lies in its write scope (the suite gate is unarmed), so no suite pair exists to difference. Its gate is the route comparison, section-check.log, whose header names revision 4453b6f674a89e0507f49c8b2c46f3f8723c5da4 and the section_route.py command, and whose last two lines are 'ROUTE-CHECK differences=0' and 'EXIT=0'. I re-ran the same script against the head copies of the section and the map in a scratch directory: it printed differences=0 and exited 0, and with --add shared=nova/utilities/ANSYS.py it printed differences=2 naming that module and exited 1. Added failures: none.

findings.text: Six of the seven delivered paths -- nova/equilibrium/AGENTS.md, section_route.py, route-modules.json and the three driver edits in forward_route.py/job.sh/map.py -- lie outside the two declared write paths (the evidence fragment HTML and the figures directory). The work is what plan s6 and the brief require ('Write the route section in nova/equilibrium/AGENTS.md', 'Compare the section against a fresh s1 measurement using the landed s1 driver'), so the defect is the declaration, not the work; it is recorded so the coordinator can ratify the shared paths.

Nothing invokes this check automatically: a grep over nova/, scripts/, tests/ and docs/ finds section_route.py named only in AGENTS.md prose and in the evidence fragment -- no test, commit hook or CI target runs it -- so the documented route can drift out of step with the measured map and the guard would not fire until a reader runs it by hand. The locked decision hot-path-guard: document-only forbids an enforcing test, so the section's 'run the check in the same commit that changes one' is the whole guard; the finding records that it is a convention with nothing binding it.

The section says 'The plan-level record of §1's measurement is <path>'; §1 is a plan-section label; a reader without code-reuse-and-hot-path cannot resolve the label. Repository documents must stand alone by the naming guidance, and the path it cites (docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/hot-path-map.html) already identifies the record without the section number.
